description: The 81 m bell tower of 1505-08 and 1600 with the Assumption Belfry and Patriarch Filaret's annexe: three white octagons with arched bell openings, a ring of gilded kokoshniks, the drum with its blue lettered band and gilded dome; the broad belfry with its great bell arches, drum and gilded dome; the annexe's tent roof and corner tents; the arcaded west porch and its stair.
